subject: maths

concepts.title: Order of a Differential Equation
concepts.definition: The order of a differential equation is defined as the order of the highest derivative of the dependent variable present in the differential equation.
concepts.key_idea: Identify the highest derivative term present in the differential equation.
question_patterns: find the order of the differential equation
determine the order of the given differential equation
what is the order of the differential equation
calculate the order of the differential equation
Explain the method of Order of a Differential Equation.

solution_steps.explain: List all derivatives of the dependent variable occurring in the differential equation.
Find the maximum derivative order present to get the order of the differential equation.

solution_steps.action: State the order as the highest derivative order found
solution_steps.explain: The order of the differential equation equals the order of the highest derivative identified in the previous step.

concepts.title: Degree of a Differential Equation
concepts.definition: The degree of a differential equation is the highest exponent of its highest order derivative when expressed as a polynomial in derivatives.
concepts.key_idea: Check polynomial form in derivatives to extract the power of the highest derivative.
question_patterns: find the degree of the differential equation
determine the degree if defined for the differential equation
check whether the degree of the differential equation is defined
calculate the degree of the differential equation
Explain the method of Degree of a Differential Equation.

solution_steps.explain: Verify whether the equation is a polynomial in derivative terms.
Determine the power raised on the highest order derivative if defined.

solution_steps.action: State the degree or report it as undefined
solution_steps.explain: If the equation is a polynomial in derivatives, the degree is the exponent of the highest order derivative; otherwise the degree is not defined.

concepts.title: Verification of Solutions of Differential Equations
concepts.definition: A solution curve satisfies a differential equation when replacing the dependent variable and its derivatives yields an identity.
concepts.key_idea: Compute required derivatives and substitute them into the differential equation to verify equality.
question_patterns: verify that the given function is a solution of the differential equation
check if the function satisfies the differential equation
show that the function is a solution of the given differential equation
determine whether the given relation is a solution
Explain the method of Verification of Solutions of Differential Equations.

solution_steps.explain: Calculate first and higher derivatives of y with respect to x as required.
Substitute y and its derivatives into the left side of the differential equation and simplify to check equality with RHS.
If the substituted expression reduces to an identity, the given function is a valid solution of the differential equation.

concepts.title: Differential Equations with Variables Separable
concepts.definition: A first-order differential equation dy/dx = g(x)h(y) can be solved by placing y terms with dy and x terms with dx followed by integration.
concepts.key_idea: Group all terms involving y with dy on one side and x with dx on the other side.
question_patterns: find the general solution of the differential equation by variable separation
solve the differential equation using separation of variables
calculate the solution of the separable differential equation
find the particular solution for the separable differential equation
Explain the method of Differential Equations with Variables Separable.

solution_steps.explain: Rewrite the differential equation in the form (1/h(y)) dy = g(x) dx.
Integrate both sides independently and add a constant of integration C.
Express the integrated result as an implicit relation between y and x, applying initial conditions if a particular solution is required.

concepts.title: Continuous Growth and Compounding Models
concepts.definition: Models where rate of growth of a quantity is proportional to itself form a differential equation leading to exponential time behavior.
concepts.key_idea: Set up dP/dt = (r/100)*P to solve continuous compounding or population growth problems.
question_patterns: in how many years will principal double at rate
find the time taken for an amount to double under continuous interest
calculate the rate of interest if principal doubles in given years
compute the time required for doubling at continuous rate
Explain the method of Continuous Growth and Compounding Models.

solution_steps.explain: Multiply 100 by log2
Divide the factor by annual interest rate
The computed doubling time gives the number of years required for the principal to double at the given continuous rate of growth.

concepts.title: Homogeneous Differential Equations (y/x Substitution)
concepts.definition: A differential equation dy/dx = F(x,y) where F is homogeneous of degree zero is solved by making substitution y = vx.
concepts.formula: y = v * x => dy/dx = v + x * dv/dx
concepts.key_idea: Substitute y = vx to transform a homogeneous equation in dy/dx into a variable separable equation.
question_patterns: show that the differential equation is homogeneous and solve it
find the general solution of the homogeneous differential equation
solve the homogeneous differential equation using y = vx
verify homogeneity and solve the differential equation
Explain the method of Homogeneous Differential Equations (y/x Substitution).

solution_steps.explain: Verify F(lambda*x, lambda*y) = lambda^0 * F(x,y).
Replace y with vx and dy/dx with v + x(dv/dx).
Separate v and x variables, integrate, and substitute back v = y/x.

concepts.title: Homogeneous Differential Equations (x/y Substitution)
concepts.definition: A differential equation dx/dy = F(x,y) where F is homogeneous of degree zero is solved by substituting x = vy.
concepts.formula: x = v * y => dx/dy = v + y * dv/dy
concepts.key_idea: Use x = vy substitution when the differential equation is presented as dx/dy = h(x/y).
question_patterns: solve the homogeneous equation of the form dx/dy = h(x/y)
find the particular solution using x = vy substitution
solve the differential equation in dx/dy using substitution
verify homogeneity for dx/dy equation and find general solution
Explain the method of Homogeneous Differential Equations (x/y Substitution).

solution_steps.explain: Write the differential equation as dx/dy = h(x/y).
Replace x with vy and dx/dy with v + y(dv/dy).
Separate v and y variables, integrate, and substitute back v = x/y.

concepts.title: First Order Linear Differential Equations (dy/dx + Py = Q)
concepts.definition: A differential equation dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) is linear in y and solved by using an integrating factor IF = exp(integral(P dx)).
concepts.formula: IF = e^(integral(P dx)), y * IF = integral(Q * IF dx) + C
concepts.key_idea: Identify P(x) and Q(x), compute IF, and integrate Q * IF to derive the solution.
question_patterns: find the general solution of the linear differential equation dy/dx + Py = Q
find the integrating factor and solve the differential equation
calculate the particular solution of first order linear differential equation
solve the linear differential equation dy/dx + Py = Q
Explain the method of First Order Linear Differential Equations (dy/dx + Py = Q).

solution_steps.explain: Write equation in standard form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) to identify P and Q.
Compute IF = exp(integral(P dx)).
Use y * IF = integral(Q * IF dx) + C to find the solution.

concepts.title: First Order Linear Differential Equations (dx/dy + Px = Q)
concepts.definition: A differential equation dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y) is linear in x and solved by using an integrating factor IF = exp(integral(P dy)).
concepts.formula: IF = e^(integral(P dy)), x * IF = integral(Q * IF dy) + C
concepts.key_idea: Identify P(y) and Q(y), compute IF with respect to y, and integrate Q * IF.
question_patterns: find the general solution of linear differential equation dx/dy + Px = Q
find the integrating factor of dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y)
solve first order linear differential equation in x
calculate general solution when equation is linear in x
Explain the method of First Order Linear Differential Equations (dx/dy + Px = Q).

solution_steps.explain: Express the equation in standard form dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y).
Compute IF = exp(integral(P dy)).
Use x * IF = integral(Q * IF dy) + C to obtain the solution.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the order and degree, if defined, of each of the differential equations: (i) dy/dx - cos x = 0 (ii) x y (d2y/dx2) + x (dy/dx)2 - y (dy/dx) = 0 (iii) y''' + y2 + e^(y') = 0

solution_template.action: determine order and degree for eq1
solution_template.explain: Highest derivative is dy/dx, so order = 1; polynomial power raised is 1, so degree = 1.

solution_template.action: determine order and degree for eq2
solution_template.explain: Highest derivative is d2y/dx2, so order = 2; power raised on highest derivative is 1, so degree = 1.

solution_template.action: determine order and degree for eq3
solution_template.explain: Highest derivative is y''', so order = 3; equation is not polynomial in derivatives due to e^(y'), so degree is not defined.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Verify that the function y = e^(-3x) is a solution of the differential equation d2y/dx2 + dy/dx - 6y = 0

solution_template.explain: LHS = 9 e^(-3x) + (-3 e^(-3x)) - 6 (e^(-3x)) = 0 = RHS. Hence verified.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the particular solution of the differential equation dy/dx = -4xy^2 given that y = 1 when x = 0

solution_template.explain: Integral gives -1/y = -2x^2 + C. Using x = 0, y = 1 gives C = -1, so y = 1 / (2x^2 + 1).

worked_examples.question_pattern: In a bank, principal increases continuously at the rate of {rate}% per year. In how many years Rs 1000 double itself?
Show that the differential equation (x - y) dy/dx = x + 2y is homogeneous and solve it

solution_template.explain: v + x(dv/dx) = (1 + 2v)/(1 - v), separate variables, integrate and substitute v = y/x to get log(x^2 + xy + y^2) = 2*sqrt(3)*arctan((x+2y)/(sqrt(3)*x)) + C.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the general solution of the differential equation dy/dx - y = cos x

solution_template.explain: y * e^(-x) = integral(e^(-x) cos x dx) + C = (sinx - cosx) e^(-x) / 2 + C, so y = (sinx - cosx)/2 + C e^x.
